SR-80

STEERING — Power Steering (Gear Housing)

16. REMOVE CYLINDER HOUSING OIL SEAL AND SPACER
Using SST, tap out the oil seal and spacer.
SST 09631-12020, 09631-20031

[Diagram D0431 showing SST tool usage]

INSPECTION AND REPAIR OF GEAR HOUSING COMPONENTS

1. INSPECT RACK
(a) Check the rack for runout and for teeth wear or damage.
(b) Check the back surface for wear or damage.
If faulty, replace it.
Maximum runout: 0.3 mm (0.012 in.)

[Diagram D2798 showing rack inspection]

2. IF NECESSARY, REPLACE RACK HOUSING BEARING AND OIL SEAL
(a) Using SST, remove the bearing.
SST 09612-30012
NOTICE: Be careful not to damage the rack housing.

[Diagram SR2822 showing SST tool usage]

(b) Using SST, remove the oil seal.
SST 09612-30012
NOTICE: Be careful not to damage the rack housing.

[Diagram SR2823 showing SST tool usage]

(c) Using SST, install a new oil seal.
SST 09620-30010 (09624-30010, 09631-00020)

[Diagram SR2824 showing SST tool usage]
